o.text: From Classical Persian قرمزی (qirmizī, “crimson”), from Arabic قِرْمِزِيّ (qirmiziyy, “crimson”). Compare Turkish kırmızı.
Borrowed from Arabic شَمَالِيّ (šamāliyy). By surface analysis, şimal + -i.
Internationalism. From Russian этимология (etimologija). Ultimately from Ancient Greek ἐτυμολογία (etumología, “study of true senses”).
From Ottoman Turkish جمهوریت (cumhuriyet). See more at Arabic جُمْهُورِيَّة (jumhūriyya).
From Persian بیناموس (bi-nâmus). Equivalent to bi- + namus.
